title: Te Reo i te Rakau e Mura Ana
intro: Wetekina te tuakiri o tētahi tangata hohonu i tīmata tana haerenga i tētahi tūtakitanga merekara, ā, i honoa tōna mutunga ki te whakaoranga o te iwi e tukinotia ana. I whiriwhiria tēnei tangata mō tētahi mahi nui, me te aro atu ki ngā wero nunui me te tautoko a te Atua.
clues: I whānau mai ahau i te wā o te tukino nui, i te wā i kohurutia ai ngā pēpi o tōku iwi.
I tōku tamarikitanga i makahia ahau ki roto i te awa e ōku mātua, heoi i kitea ahau, i whakatipuria hoki i roto i te whare tonu o te kaitukino o tōku iwi.
I oma atu ahau i tētahi tāone i muri i taku whakamatenga i tētahi tangata i roto i tētahi tautohe.
I tae mai he karere atua me tētahi tokotoko merekara ki ahau i tētahi wāhi tapu, ā, i whakahaua mai ahau ki reira kia tū atu ki tētahi rangatira mana nui.
I whakatūria tōku tungāne hei kaiawhina mōku i roto i taku misioni, nā te mea i kitea he arai i roto i taku kōrero.
I ārahi ahau i tōku iwi i whiti i te moana kua pakaru, i mawhiti atu i te whai a te ope taua nanakia.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Ngā tau maroke e mau tonu ana
Te tū atu ki a Parao me āna tohunga makutu
Te maka ki roto i te oumu mura
Te whakangaromanga o te iwi o Thamud
trial.answer: Te tū atu ki a Parao me āna tohunga makutu

outcome.label: Hua
options: I hurihia te pa o Horoma
I horomia te iwi e te whenua
I taupokina te whenua e te waipuke nui
I toremi a Parao rātou ko tana ope taua
I hinga ngā taiepa o te tāone i te tangi
outcome.answer: I toremi a Parao rātou ko tana ope taua

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
